visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a completed miniature of a traditional Taiwanese grocery store sitting on a light wooden desk. A small blue-and-white cat figurine stands next to it. The scene cuts to a 7-11 retail store interior, showing high-contrast promotional posters for a Lexus car giveaway and a HeySong 100th-anniversary event. Shelves are stocked with various bottled beverages, including sodas and teas, under bright fluorescent lighting. (2) A person's hands with dark, glittery nail polish are shown unboxing a wooden DIY kit package. The hands pop out small, laser-cut wooden pieces from a flat sheet. Detailed actions follow: the individual applies Scotch-brand white liquid glue to the edges of small wooden tabs and uses a toothpick to spread the adhesive evenly. Multiple tiny components like miniature soda crates and a red scooter are meticulously assembled in a series of fast-cut shots. (3) The finished 'Kan-a-tiam' miniature is showcased on a rotating wooden display stand, revealing intricate details like a small electric fan, cat figures, and 'Taiwan' lettering. A real tabby cat enters the frame from the top, sniffing the model curiously. The miniature is then repurposed as a stationery holder, with a mechanical pencil and a pen placed inside it. The video ends with a shot of the miniature rotating while the real cat sits in the background near a computer monitor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a very high-energy male narrator speaking rapidly in Traditional Chinese over a driving, upbeat electronic pop track. The music features bright synth stabs and a consistent electronic drum kick. A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator emphasizes the 7-11 promotion. The background is clean with virtually no ambient store noise audible, suggesting a post-produced voice-over. (2) As the unboxing begins, the vocal pitch remains high and enthusiastic. Intentional foley sound effects, specifically crisp wooden 'clicks' and 'pops', are mixed in to simulate the sound of breaking pieces from the wooden sheet. A soft liquid 'squish' or sliding sound effect accompanies the application of glue. The BGM remains steady in volume and tempo. (3) The narrator reaches a celebratory peak with a 'Tadah!' exclamation. The music maintains its energetic major-mode feel with layered percussion. Rapid-fire descriptions of the miniature's details follow, with each point accentuated by subtle percussive hit SFX. The recording concludes with a final energetic call to action, the voice and music both remaining at a high arousal level until a quick hard-cut ending.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a limited-edition HeySong 100th-anniversary 'Kan-a-tiam' (traditional grocery store) DIY miniature kit available at 7-11. It uses an enthusiastic narration style and detailed assembly footage to showcase the charm and high quality of the collectible, encouraging viewers to purchase beverages to obtain the kit before it sells out.
